scope: End-to-end public-event recurrent state, explicit entity retrieval, learned action forecasts, cost planner, symbolic admissibility, native execution and receipt-gated writes. Not a learned CDL router or learned CASM executor.

evidence_gate.inherited: DEV-051 action imitation and DEV-052A frozen transfer limitation
evidence_gate.unknown: Whether matched-capability recurrent predictive state improves decisions
new_rows: L3 native end-to-end cost and reliability

generator.native_effects: Sequential absorbing healthy state; independent attempt outcomes. Failed later repair never resurrects a repaired fault. No inherited required-action-count oracle; completion is target-state and resource invariants.
generator.sensor: Harness projects only paid inspected bit, independent hash stream per world/entity/read. Native state and trace stay harness-only.

training.collection: One exhaustive bounded exploration trajectory per train entity: four inspections interleaved with all three isolate/service attempts, fixed schedule selected by public seeded exploration independent of hidden faults. Common data reused across model seeds.
training.targets: Hidden fault bit at public-event positions, train-only actual paired WAIT/each repair outcomes from native oracle effects; inspection accuracy target from charged training inspections. All oracle queries counted. Estimated Bayes uses same labeled training trajectories.
training.forecast_loss: BCE wait fault + mean BCE three paired repair faults + BCE sensor correctness; recurrent_belief uses wait loss only and estimated transition parameters at deployment
training.decision_loss: Cross entropy against estimated-parameter public Bayesian action at same public histories; weight 1 for joint/frozen writer and policy-only arms
training.frozen_writer: Same seed/init; event GRU frozen, heads trained
training.last_event: Tanh linear encoder of only current public event plus current public attempt/read counters; no recurrent state
training.dagger: 128 updates common exploration; collect one student trajectory on each training world with public Bayes labels, no evaluation; 128 updates on combined initial and student data
training.validation: Report final fixed-update predictive scores; no early stopping or model selection

calibration.temperature_selection: Lowest calibration exploration wait NLL, ties first. No model update. Policy-only temperature fixed 1.
calibration.risk_selection: For predictive arms, lowest actual calibration cost among candidates with no more residual faults or blocked calls than estimated Bayes; if none qualify minimize residual faults then cost. Policy-only fixed multiplier1. No baseline tuning on evaluation.
calibration.uncertainty: Bernoulli predictive entropy; no rule fallback or OOD detection claim

planning.bayes: Finite horizon DP over p(fault), attempt index, read count, paid inspect and isolate+service with four-sense cap. Known Bayes gets true regime externally; all other arms never receive shifted probabilities.
planning.neural: Read p(fault), conditional repair-success heads and accuracy head from entity state; same DP with rates fixed during each lookahead, updated after actual receipts. Heads predict paired service risk as p(fault)*(1-success).
planning.rounding: Probabilities 8 decimal places for Bellman cache. Cache cleared per learned decision to bound memory.
planning.table: Empirical fault frequency keyed by attempt count and ordered public reading bits grouped by repair attempt, with estimated-Bayes smoothing 2 pseudocounts; same estimated transition DP.
planning.constraints: Explicit, shared: service requires isolation, max3 attempts, max4 reads, one slot. DONE remains legal. Accepted receipts commit; blocked receipts do not write learned state. Service macro requires both charged native isolate and service; both recorded.

evaluation.pass_guard: Per arm and seed, both in-regime and shifted: residual faults <= estimated Bayes, blocked/trajectory violations <= baseline, actual cost strictly less. No pooling repeated worlds as independent trials.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap 2000 resamples over world index, model seeds averaged within each world; shifted bootstrap stratified by four regime families. Descriptive development intervals only.

audit: Separate process reconstruct checkpoints from deterministic training, calibration choices and every policy trace; independently replay recorded primitive actions through pinned native runtime and separately sum action charges, faults and path constraints. Artifact hashes and disjoint IDs required.
budget: Complete 35 neural fits x256 updates, two native passes plus replay; no post-evaluation tuning. Preserve failed runs. Approx30 minutes CPU research budget, report overrun if needed.
limitations: Two known entities and one shared resource only
Explicit entity addressing and symbolic execution constraints
Model-based lookahead fixes learned rates within imagined tree
Training supervision includes synthetic privileged targets shared with fitted baselines
Five seeds adaptive development, not independent confirmation
No real-world or complete generic TAC-OSM superiority claim
